_comment: Template. Copy to <brandname>.json (the filename IS the brand name, matching brands/<brandname>/logo.png) and fill in. Files starting with _ are skipped by the loader. 'group' is the account family the news bot's pickers offer as one row (GMN / JNN); omit it and the brand is reachable only through their Custom list. Omit a platform block entirely when the brand has no account there. 'account' overrides the credential name, which defaults to the brand name. YouTube keeps its OAuth in credentials/youtube/<channel>/ - 'channel' only names that folder. Shared services (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, BULKFOLLOWS_*, SMTP, bot tokens) stay in .env. Check with: py shared/credentials.py --check
